purpose: Places RM-01 under mechanical causal replay for the first time. Locks the Phase-2-owned half of SPR-D-01: the formation-gate trace, the as-of-time selection over bars 0..9, and line_at_stop at the engine-derived stop (bar 10). Half A — the full-series geometry — lives in annotation.json and is not restated here; neither layer supersedes the other.

provenance.author_independence: Authored by the orchestrating session of 2026-07-26, which HAS READ tools/fixture-replay.mjs and is therefore permanently DISQUALIFIED from authoring the Phase 2 engine (HD-15 condition 2 / E2-AUTHOR-B). The Phase 2 engine must be authored by a different agent that has read neither the reference model nor this file. E2-AUTHOR-A governs where the two diverge: the committed engine/ must not import, copy, execute or mechanically translate the reference model, and that is the property assessed at the gate.
provenance.note: SPR-D-01 limit 3 resolved to its TRUE value for this artifact. The limit is stated conditionally elsewhere ("if the Half B expectation is generated by tools/fixture-replay.mjs"); for this file the condition HOLDS. These values were produced by applying the reference model to RM-01 bars, so this document is a regression guard against today's model and CANNOT detect that the model itself is wrong. RM-01's non-circularity attaches to Half A's human-approved geometry and to the real, undesigned prices — never to this file's provenance.

assertable_surface.rationale: SPR-D-01 limit 2: Half B NARROWS RM-01's Phase-2 assertable surface. Under Half A alone (confirmed_bar == null) RM-01's complete final state and full reason-code set were Phase-2 assertable; here only bars 0-9 plus correct identification of the stop index are. "The gate is strengthened" is TRUE of the gate as a whole — RM-01 goes from no mechanical guard at all to a comparison contract — and FALSE of RM-01's own assertable surface. Neither sentence may travel without the other.

not_asserted.rationale: SPR-D-01 limit 1. Phase 3 owns confirmed breakout, retest, failure and expiry by Product Owner ruling, so this file asserts line_at_stop and NOT the frozen line Λ^F, and asserts no BROKEN_OUT state and no BREAKOUT_CONFIRMED reason code. tools/fixture-replay.mjs asserts these exclusions in both directions: it fails if this list shrinks, and it fails if the fixture starts carrying the forbidden fields.

robustness.verdict: ROBUST. The stop index is invariant at bar 10 across eps_break 0.5x-5x and eps 0.5x-2x, so HD-13's tolerance-robustness requirement is met and no outcome here is decided by a tolerance. It is NOT invariant under min_formation_bars: 8-10 stop at bar 10, 11 stops at bar 11, and 12+ produce no stop at all. That parameter is ratified at 8 (HD-14 / D-TL-12) and the 8-vs-12 question is deliberately left to Phase 4 population evidence rather than fitted to this single 29-bar series.

non_endorsement: SPR-D-01 mandatory clause, required to appear on the artifact and not only in the register. This is an EVIDENTIARY CONFORMANCE EXPECTATION, NOT AN ECONOMIC ENDORSEMENT. 4UR4 does not assert that the bar-10 signal is a good trade. It exemplifies a short-history / post-IPO candidate false-positive class, and whether that class should be suppressed is an open Phase 4 backtest question, deliberately not answered by SPR-D-01.

geometry_check.anchor: A = (t=2, 2026-06-16, 225.64) — earliest argmax high over the available prefix (§4, §21.1).
geometry_check.margin_identity: close_vs_line_log − close_vs_line_plus_eps_break_log = eps_break = 0.01, exactly. The first is the raw clearance ln(close) − ŷ and is the quantity the register, roadmap and fixtures/README call "the margin"; the second is what the reference model stores in its own events[].margin field.
geometry_check.suppression: Suppressing the bar-10 stop by tolerance would require eps_break ≥ 0.0864461, ≈8.6× the documented 0.01 — and HD-13 forbids resolving fixture outcomes by tolerance in any case.
geometry_check.notes: Every value is derived only from bars strictly earlier than the bar it judges (§21 / HD-12 / D-TL-11). The bar-9 INVALID_PIERCE / WICK_BREAK re-selects B* to (9, 158.40) effective bar 10 (§21.6), which is why the line judging bar 10 is bound at bar 9 and not at the full-series hull vertex (25, 129.88).
